models.description: Official Microsoft BitNet b1.58 2B-4T GGUF bundle; native Rbitnet BitNet path for general.architecture=bitnet and ternary TQ weights.
models.notes: Install with `rbitnet models install bitnet:2b --dir ./models` (or id `microsoft-bitnet-b1.58-2b-4t`). Tokenizer sidecars come from microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T; set RBITNET_TOKENIZER or use the generated rbitnet.manifest.json paths. Enable RBITNET_TRUSTED_MODELS_ONLY=1 to require this SHA-256.
models.min_ram: 4 GB plus runtime headroom for the official i2_s / ternary GGUF
models.smoke_test: rbitnet models install microsoft-bitnet-b1.58-2b-4t --dir ./models && $env:RBITNET_MODEL=(Resolve-Path ./models/microsoft-bitnet-b1.58-2b-4t/**/*.gguf | Select-Object -First 1); cargo run -p bitnet-core --example engine_smoke

models.description: TinyLlama 1.1B chat, Llama-architecture GGUF. Good first CPU smoke model. Recommended reference for optional golden tests (docs/GOLDEN_TESTS.md).
models.notes: Install with `rbitnet models install tinyllama:q4 --dir ./models` or `rbitnet up tinyllama:q4`. Tokenizer.json is required from TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 (not the GGUF repo).
models.min_ram: 4 GB for Q4_K_M plus runtime headroom
models.smoke_test: cargo test -p rbitnet-cli parse_minimal_catalog && RBITNET_TEST_GGUF=/path/to/model.gguf cargo test -p bitnet-core optional_gguf_from_env_smoke -- --nocapture

models.description: Meta Llama 3.2 1B Instruct quantized by Unsloth; Llama loader compatible by architecture metadata.
models.notes: Windows CPU recipe and SHA-256/path checked on 2026-10-03: the HTTP capital-of-France response is Paris. The same GGUF has published CPU/CUDA benchmarks and real-model greedy sequence checks. See docs/validation/2026-10-03-unsloth-llama32-1b.json, docs/UNSLOTH_TO_RBITNET.md and docs/benchmarks/2026-10-03-parity-round2/README.md. This validates the prebuilt pack, not a training or local export run. Use chat format llama3. The failed 2026-10-02 smoke is retained separately.
models.min_ram: 4 GB for Q4_K_M plus runtime headroom
models.smoke_test: cargo test -p rbitnet-cli parse_minimal_catalog && RBITNET_TEST_GGUF=/path/to/model.gguf cargo test -p bitnet-core optional_gguf_from_env_smoke -- --nocapture

models.description: Meta Llama 3.2 3B Instruct quantized by Unsloth; Llama-architecture GGUF.
models.notes: HF API reports gguf.architecture=llama and context_length=131072. Needs tokenizer from the base Meta Llama 3.2 repo or a local exported tokenizer.json.
models.min_ram: 8 GB for Q4_K_M plus runtime headroom
models.smoke_test: cargo test -p rbitnet-cli parse_minimal_catalog && RBITNET_TEST_GGUF=/path/to/model.gguf cargo test -p bitnet-core optional_gguf_from_env_smoke -- --nocapture

models.description: Hermes 2 Pro on Llama 3 8B, ChatML-style instruct GGUF.
models.notes: HF API reports gguf.architecture=llama and context_length=8192. Download tokenizer.json from NousResearch/Hermes-2-Pro-Llama-3-8B and use RBITNET_CHAT_FORMAT=chatml.
models.min_ram: 16 GB for Q4_K_M plus runtime headroom
models.smoke_test: cargo test -p rbitnet-cli parse_minimal_catalog && RBITNET_TEST_GGUF=/path/to/model.gguf cargo test -p bitnet-core optional_gguf_from_env_smoke -- --nocapture
